subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the redirect fix and stack-base review, should the exact final head be authorized to remove the temporary qa-matrix workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: Repository automation deliberately blocks dependency-graph changes until a repository admin or security owner confirms that the package removal is intentional and safe for the accepted stack.

options.title: Authorize after redirect fix
options.body: Add both documentation redirects, verify the accepted stack still owns all Matrix QA behavior, then approve the exact final head for dependency removal.

options.title: Retain the temporary package
options.body: Keep the compatibility package and importer until maintainers choose a later cleanup window with independent upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the final stack PR
options.body: Leave this PR open without authorization until the preceding Matrix QA stack is landed or otherwise resolved.

recommendation.title: Authorize after redirect fix
recommendation.body: Add both documentation redirects, verify the accepted stack still owns all Matrix QA behavior, then approve the exact final head for dependency removal.

likelyOwner.reason: As the four-PR stack owner, this person is best positioned to present the exact ownership and package-removal proof to the required admin or security approver.
